text:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout v2.3.1-rc5 => 5% traffic in eu-west. Change window 23:00-02:00 UTC. Monitoring p95, errors, kv-hit. Reply with /deploy pin or /deploy abort.
ashley: seeing p95 +14% on traces, tail around +1.1s on long requests. Not yet customer-impacting but noisy.
diego: tail correlates with increased kvcache misses on a small subset of hosts after shift. grabbing logs.
nina: could be cold-kv population with the new kernel path. If not stabilizing in 8-10m, propose soft-pin region back to rc4 instead of full rollback.
sam: agree. soft-pin eu-west to rc4 for 30m, keep global rollout running. Avoid global rollback unless 5xx spikes.
deploy-bot: To confirm: `/deploy pin v2.3.1-rc4 --region eu-west --duration 30m --note "soft-pin: kv warmup"` — execute?
ashley: please do the pin and kick off a quick smoke against edge nodes. Also add a short dataplane trace capture for the affected hosts.
deploy-bot: Executing pin...

```
/-- deploy-bot activity log --/
cmd: /deploy pin v2.3.1-rc4 --region eu-west --duration 30m --note "soft-pin: kv warmup"
status: accepted
action: traffic re-routed to v2.3.1-rc4 for eu-west
ess: ~20s
eta: ~20s
```

ashley: confirmed traffic flipped. p95 trending down to +3% within 4m. kv hit ratio sampled: 66% -> 90% on affected hosts.
diego: logs show lock backoff on new kernel code causing cold cache penalty. I'll open a hotfix PR to revert the risky backoff change.
nina: smoke tests green (basic convo + rate-limit checks). No 5xx spike. Recommend leave pin for full 30m to ensure steady-state.
sam: added QA checklist item: p95 within 3% baseline, 5xx <= 0.3%, kv-hit >= 85% for 15m. Please tag when ready.
sre-bot: Created incident note INC-2026-0422  canary tail-latency observed; soft-pin applied eu-west. Owner: diego. Severity: low.
deploy-bot: Pin will auto-expire at +30m unless extended with `/deploy pin extend 30m --region eu-west`. To unpin early: `/deploy unpin --region eu-west`.
ashley: will re-check at +10m and +25m. If stable, let it expire and resume rolling tomorrow's 20% warm window. Add a release-notes blurb.
sam: drafting release notes: "During 5% canary, observed kv cold-cache penalty on rc5. Soft-pin applied to eu-west to rc4; hotfix PR in flight. Resuming staged rollout after pin expires and verification." Link: https://release-notes.redwood.dev/v2.3.1-rc5
diego: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/ab12cd - revert backoff tweak. Will coordinate quick CI run once rc5 traffic fully resumes.
nina: leaving oncall comment: watch p95 and kv-hit ratio for eu-west for next hour. If any 5xx increase, escalate immediately.
ashley: thanks all. Closing thread when pin expires or if someone manually resumes.
sre-bot: Reminder scheduled in 20m: eu-west canary health check.
